title: Terrain count-raster descriptor
description: Engine-owned layout of a count raster (CT-21, ADR-8542, docs/formats/terrain.md § 14): spacing on X and Z, stored row/column order, sample-center or cell-edge registration, nodata value and valid mask. External schema-2 JSON is unchanged and equals {raster_descriptor: 1, spacing_m: [cell_m, cell_m], registration: center}. Unknown fields are an error. Kept in step with the serde fields by regia_terrain's test `the_json_schema_names_every_descriptor_field`.

raster_descriptor.description: Descriptor version. Another version is refused with terrain_raster_version before any other field is read.

spacing_m.description: Distance between adjacent samples on X and on Z, meters; positive and finite.

skew_m.description: Rotation terms of the affine transform (X change per row, Z change per column), meters. Only [0, 0] is supported; anything else is refused with terrain_raster_transform and never resampled.

row0.description: Which edge stored row 0 is: south = minimum Z, north = maximum Z (a north-up image's top row). Normalized by exact index permutation.

col0.description: Which edge stored column 0 is: west = minimum X, east = maximum X.

registration.description: What origin_m names: center = the minimum-corner sample itself (GDAL Point); edge = the outer corner of the minimum-corner cell (GDAL Area), samples sit spacing / 2 inside on each axis. Required: a half-cell shift is never implied.

origin_m.description: World X/Z of the minimum-X/minimum-Z registration point, whichever corner the raster stores first. Absent: -dimension * spacing / 2 per axis (the schema-2 default).

nodata_counts.description: A count meaning no data. Such samples are missing: kept verbatim, never turned into a height.

valid.description: cols * rows entries in the raster's stored order: 1 = data, 0 = missing.

valid_mask.description: Explicit valid-data mask, combined with nodata_counts.
